about: parseEXR(bytes) from packages/environment/src/exr.ts. Synthetic fixtures were written by the reference OpenEXR library (generate.py); AllHalfValues/BrightRings come from openexr-images. dataSha256 = SHA-256 of the returned Float32Array bytes (little-endian); f32Sha256 = the matching .f32 file the reference library decoded. Binding: data bit exact. Damaged-file outcomes: "throws vs decodes", error name and code binding; messages are Margo wording. Flip positions are byte offsets into the named base file.
